methodology: A primary document proves a dated institutional act or finding within its jurisdiction. It does not make every allegation reproduced in the document true.

Status dates are dates of the retained decision or reply, not assertions of current docket status. No finding of personal guilt follows from a constitutional ruling, arrest review, complaint, charge, refusal of a remedy or shared graph path.
Judges are linked only as verified authors or bench members of specific dated decisions. No judge-to-donor, judge-to-party, or judge-to-corruption inference is generated.
Historical proceedings and underlying transaction periods are explicit. No legal rule is applied backwards merely because it appears in a newer source.

All 12 retained sources were downloaded from the issuing court, regulator or Parliament. The evidence archive contains labelled PDF excerpts, text extracts, original hashes and page maps. Personal tax identifiers are excluded.
